svg.aria-label: Stage Box assembly steps and drawer locks
svg.text: Part outlines match the cut sheets. Keep every moving joint free of glue. These views are not cutting templates.

g.text: Glue the walls to B; leave the lid off.
Fit FLOOR and W into their wall slots.
Keep the three sliding floor slots clear of glue.
Fit PIN freely through P. Do not glue PIN to P.
Glue DAGGER outside and ARM inside onto PIN.
Both point the same way. Glue POST to ARM’s tip.
Glue the drawer’s five panels together.
Glue COMB into the notch on top of DF.
Fingers point left when seen from the back.
Stack and glue two PEG blocks behind C;
repeat behind D1, at the marked positions.
Keep the sliding slots free of glue.
From the front: C, then D1, then D2.
C takes ARM’s post. Pegs enter the next plate.
Slide all right; push the drawer in from the back.
Fit T over the two curtain pull tabs.
Test: dagger left, front curtain left, rear left,
then pull the drawer back. See the views below.
How the locks release the drawer
FRONT (P) — looking down below the floor
3 skirts still block the gold comb.
Gold = drawer comb; colored bars = plate skirts.
FRONT (P) — looking down below the floor
2 skirts still block the gold comb.
Gold = drawer comb; colored bars = plate skirts.
FRONT (P) — looking down below the floor
1 skirt still blocks the gold comb.
Gold = drawer comb; colored bars = plate skirts.
FRONT (P) — looking down below the floor
All skirts clear the comb. Pull the drawer BACK.
Gold = drawer comb; colored bars = plate skirts.
Close in reverse: push the drawer in, then D2 right, D1 right, dagger right.
